questions.prompt: Eloquent nima va Active Record pattern qanday ishlaydi?

options.text: Laravel ORM: model — jadval, instansiya — qator; model o'zini saqlaydi va o'chiradi (`save()`, `find()`)

options.hint: Query Builder — SQL vosita; Eloquent — ob'ekt mapping ustida.

options.text: Data Mapper (Doctrine kabi): model bazani bilmaydi, saqlashni esa alohida EntityManager klassi o'zi bajaradi
options.hint: Eloquent — Active Record: model DB bilan bevosita ishlaydi.
Relyatsion DB (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server).

questions.explanation: Konvensiyalar: `users` jadval, `id` PK, `created_at`/`updated_at` avtomatik; relation'lar metod sifatida. Active Record — tez va qulay, lekin model DB'ga bog'liq (domen mantiqi va persistence aralash — trade-off). `$table`, `$primaryKey`, `$timestamps = false` — konvensiyani o'zgartirish. `$fillable`/`$guarded` — mass assignment. `$casts` — tur o'girish (`'is_active' => 'boolean'`, `'meta' => 'array'`, enum).

options.text: `find` — PK bo'yicha model yoki `null`; `*OrFail` — exception (404); `first` — birinchi qator; `get` — Collection

options.hint: `null` vs exception vs Collection — xato ishlovi farq qiladi.
Collection — ko'p model.

options.text: `find` topilmasa exception tashlaydi, `findOrFail` esa `null` qaytaradi — ularning nomlari aslida aksincha ishlaydi
options.hint: `null` — `findOrFail` exception.

questions.explanation: `get()` bo'sh bo'lsa ham `null` emas, bo'sh Collection qaytaradi; `ModelNotFoundException` 404 ga aylanadi. Controller'da `findOrFail` yoki route model binding — 404 avtomatik. `firstOrCreate`/`updateOrCreate` — race condition'ga e'tibor (unique constraint + retry). `find([1,2,3])` — Collection. `sole()` — aniq bitta, ko'p/yo'q bo'lsa exception. `value('name')` — bitta ustun.

options.hint: Migratsiya — foreign key; relation — modelda.

options.text: `$user->posts` va `$user->posts()` bir xil natija beradi — ikkalasi ham bazadan yuklangan tayyor Collection qaytaradi
options.hint: Property — natija (cache), metod — so'rov (filtr qo'shish mumkin).
hasOne, hasMany, belongsTo, belongsToMany, hasManyThrough, morph*.

questions.explanation: `$user->posts()` esa query builder qaytaradi; masalan, `posts.user_id`, pivot `role_user`. Konvensiya: `user_id` tashqi kalit, pivot `role_user` (alifbo). O'zgartirish — parametrlar. `withPivot`, `withTimestamps`. Polymorphic (`morphMany`) — bitta jadval ko'p modelga (comments). `hasManyThrough` — oraliq orqali. Relation metodida `->where()` — scoped relation.

options.text: N+1: har foydalanuvchi uchun 2 ta qo'shimcha so'rov (profile, posts) — 1000 foydalanuvchida 2001 so'rov; `User::with(['profile', 'posts'])->get()` yoki `withCount('posts')`; `profile` null bo'lsa — xato (`?->`)

options.hint: Ikkalasi hamma qatorni oladi; muammo relation'larda.
To'g'ri (XSS) — lekin asosiy performance muammosi bor.
Har model o'z relation'ini alohida yuklaydi; eager loading kerak.

questions.explanation: Debug: Laravel Debugbar/Telescope so'rov sonini ko'rsatadi; `Model::preventLazyLoading(!app()->isProduction())` — dev'da lazy load exception. `withCount` — subquery, modellarni yuklamaydi. `load()` — keyinroq eager load. `with('posts:id,user_id,title')` — faqat kerakli ustunlar.

questions.prompt: Eloquent va Query Builder qanday farqlanadi va qachon qaysi biri?

options.text: Eloquent — model, relation, cast (qulay, xotira ko'p); Query Builder — xom qatorlar, tezroq, hisobot va bulk uchun

options.hint: Eloquent uning ustida qurilgan — ikkalasi ham faol.
Ob'ekt hydration — 100 000 qatorda sezilarli sekin.

options.text: Query Builder SQL injection'dan himoyalamaydi, shuning uchun foydalanuvchi ma'lumoti bilan faqat Eloquent ishlatiladi
options.hint: Ikkalasi ham binding ishlatadi; faqat `DB::raw`/`whereRaw`da ehtiyot.

questions.explanation: Eloquent ustida ham builder bor (`User::query()`); domen CRUD — Eloquent, hisobot — builder. Katta eksport: `User::query()->chunk(1000, fn($users) => ...)` yoki `cursor()`/`lazy()` (generator, bir vaqtda bitta model xotirada). `toBase()` — Eloquent so'rovni builder natijaga. `DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total')` — parametr bog'lash bilan (`selectRaw('... ?', [$x])`).

questions.prompt: Eloquent accessor, mutator va cast qanday ishlaydi?

options.text: Accessor/mutator — o'qish/yozishda o'girish (`Attribute::make`); cast — DB tur ↔ PHP tur (`datetime`, `array`, enum)
Cast DB'dagi ustun turini o'zgartiradi: masalan, `boolean` cast ustunni migratsiyasiz avtomatik `BOOLEAN` turiga o'tkazadi
options.hint: DB o'zgarmaydi — PHP tomonida o'girish.
Hisoblangan — saqlanmaydi (agar `$appends`/serializatsiya bo'lmasa, JSON'da ham ko'rinmaydi).
Cast — tur, accessor/mutator — ixtiyoriy mantiq.

questions.explanation: `$appends` accessor'ni JSON'ga qo'shadi; `encrypted` va custom `CastsAttributes` ham bor. Value object cast: `'money' => MoneyCast::class` — `get()` DB qiymatdan VO, `set()` VO'dan massiv (bir nechta ustunga ham). `'settings' => AsArrayObject::class`/`AsCollection::class`. Accessor'da relation ishlatish — N+1 xavfi (`$appends` bilan birga). `immutable_datetime` cast.

questions.code:
<?php
$orders = Order::where('status', 'pending')->get();
foreach ($orders as $order) {
    $order->status = 'processed';
    $order->save();
}

User::where('active', 0)->delete();  // 1 million qator

options.text: Birinchi: N ta UPDATE o'rniga `Order::where(...)->update(['status' => 'processed'])` (bitta so'rov — lekin model event/`updated_at` farqi); ikkinchi: `delete()` builder orqali — bitta SQL (yaxshi), lekin million qator — uzoq qulf, `chunkById` bilan bo'laklab yoki soft delete/arxiv strategiyasi; `status` string o'rniga enum

options.hint: Farqi yo'q bu yerda.
Haqiqat (builder delete — model event yo'q), lekin ataylab bo'lishi mumkin; muammo hajmda.
10 000 pending order — nechta UPDATE so'rov?

questions.explanation: Bulk `update()`/`delete()` — model event'lar (`saving`, `deleting`), observer, `$casts` mutator ishlamaydi — ongli tanlov. Event kerak bo'lsa — `chunkById(500, fn($orders) => $orders->each->update(...))`. `upsert()` — bulk insert/update. Katta o'chirish — tranzaksiya log va replika lag.

questions.prompt: Eloquent query scope'lar nima va qanday ishlatiladi?

options.text: Local scope — `scopeActive($query)` → `User::active()`; global scope — har so'rovga avtomatik (`SoftDeletes`)

options.hint: PHP darajasida so'rov qismi, DB ob'ekti emas.
`orderBy`, `with`, `join` — har qanday builder metodi.

options.text: Global scope modelga o'rnatilgandan keyin uni biror so'rov uchun vaqtincha ham o'chirishning hech qanday usuli yo'q
options.hint: `withoutGlobalScope(...)`, `withTrashed()` (SoftDeletes).

questions.explanation: `withoutGlobalScope` bilan o'chiriladi; local scope'lar zanjirlanadi va parametr ham oladi. Laravel 12: `#[Scope]` attribute. Global scope xavfi: tenant scope — admin so'rovlarda unutish yoki aksincha, ko'rinmas filtr debug'ni qiyinlashtiradi. Scope + `when($cond, fn)` — dinamik filtr. Scope ichida relation `whereHas` — subquery performance'ga e'tibor.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da DB tranzaksiya va qulflar (lock) qanday ishlatiladi?

options.text: `DB::transaction` (rollback, deadlock'da retry); `lockForUpdate` — pessimistik; versiya ustuni — optimistik
Eloquent `save()` har doim avtomatik tranzaksiyada ishlaydi, shuning uchun qo'lda tranzaksiya ochish umuman kerak emas
options.hint: Bitta so'rov — atomik; ko'p so'rov — aniq tranzaksiya kerak.
Qulf tranzaksiya tugashigacha — tashqarida darhol bo'shaydi (ma'nosiz).
Barcha qo'llanadigan DB'lar.

questions.explanation: `lockForUpdate` faqat tranzaksiya ichida ishlaydi; tranzaksiya qisqa bo'lsin, tashqi API chaqiruvi ichida bo'lmasin. Balans yechish: `DB::transaction(function() use ($id, $amt) { $acc = Account::lockForUpdate()->find($id); if ($acc->balance < $amt) throw ...; $acc->decrement('balance', $amt); })`. Tranzaksiya ichida job dispatch — `afterCommit` (aks holda job tranzaksiya commit'idan oldin ishlashi mumkin). Testda `RefreshDatabase` — nested tranzaksiya (savepoint).

questions.prompt: Quyidagi kodda qanday performance muammosi bor?

options.text: Barcha postlar va barcha kommentlar xotiraga yuklanib, filtr/saralash PHP'da — DB'da `withCount('comments')->having('comments_count', '>', 10)->orderByDesc('comments_count')->limit(20)` bo'lishi kerak; kommentlar umuman kerak emas (faqat soni)

options.hint: Farqi yo'q — ikkalasi hamma kommentni yuklaydi.
Collection `where` ham PHP'da — muammo DB'da emasligida.
100 000 post × 50 komment xotirada — necha GB?

questions.explanation: Qoida: filtrlash, saralash, agregat — DB'da; Collection — kichik natija ustida. `withCount` subquery indeks bilan tez. `whereHas('comments', fn, '>', 10)` — alternativ. `Collection` metodlari qulay — shu sabab oson tuzoq. Debugbar: so'rov soni va xotira.

questions.prompt: Eloquent model event'lari va observer'lar qanday ishlaydi, qanday tuzoqlari bor?

options.text: Hayot sikli event'lari va Observer; tuzoqlar — bulk `update()/delete()` ularni chaqirmaydi, yon ta'sir yashirin

options.hint: Delete, restore, retrieved ham.
PHP darajasida; xom SQL/bulk uni chetlab o'tadi.

options.text: Observer ichida og'ir ishlarni (email, tashqi API) sinxron bajarish to'g'ri va rasman tavsiya etilgan yondashuv
options.hint: Sinxron — so'rovni sekinlashtiradi; job dispatch (`afterCommit`).

questions.explanation: `creating/updating/deleting...`; `creating`da `false` qaytarish bekor qiladi; testda `withoutEvents()`. Observer'ga biznes mantiq yig'ish — "sehr": `User::create()` chaqirgan dasturchi email ketganini bilmaydi. Alternativa — aniq service/action klass (`CreateUser` action: yaratish + event dispatch). `UUID` generatsiya `creating`da — `HasUuids` trait buni qiladi. `saveQuietly()` — eventsiz.

questions.prompt: Katta Laravel loyihasida Eloquent modelni domen mantiqidan qanday ajratish kerak?

options.text: Ko'pincha: Eloquent qoladi, lekin mantiq action/service va DTO'larga; murakkabda — repository yoki DDD mapper
Hamma biznes mantiq modelning o'zida bo'lishi kerak — Active Record pattern'i aynan shuni majburiy talab qiladi
options.hint: 1000 qatorli `User` model — God object.
Eloquent ustida repository ko'pincha ortiqcha qatlam ("repository anti-pattern in Laravel" bahsi); faqat haqiqiy almashtirish ehtiyoji bo'lsa.
Mumkin, lekin Laravel ekotizimidan ajralish; kam loyiha buni qiladi.

questions.explanation: Repository Eloquent afzalliklarini yo'qotadi va boilerplate qo'shadi; tanlov murakkablikka bog'liq. Pragmatik Laravel: model — ma'lumot + relation + scope + cast; action (`CreateOrderAction::execute(CreateOrderData $data)`) — use case; event — yon ta'sir; Resource — API shakl; Form Request — validatsiya. Modul (`app/Modules/Orders/...`) — chegara. Testlar action darajasida — tez va aniq.

questions.prompt: Yuqori yuklanishli Laravel ilovasida DB qatlami performansini qanday ta'minlash kerak?

options.text: N+1 yo'q, kerakli ustunlar, indekslar, keyset pagination, replica, kesh, chunk, `withCount`, PgBouncer

options.hint: Eloquent to'g'ri ishlatilsa — yetarli; xom SQL — faqat issiq nuqtalarda.
Invalidatsiya murakkabligi; faqat o'lchangan issiq, kam o'zgaradigan ma'lumot.

options.text: DB serverini kuchliroq qilish yetarli — kod va so'rovlarni optimallashtirishga umuman hojat yo'q, apparat hammasini hal qiladi
options.hint: N+1 bilan kuchli server ham yiqiladi; avval kod.

questions.explanation: `preventLazyLoading`, Telescope, `EXPLAIN`, `cursorPaginate`, slow query log; PHP'da pool yo'q — PgBouncer/ProxySQL. PHP-FPM har worker — o'z DB ulanishi (pool yo'q): 200 worker × 5 pod = 1000 ulanish — PgBouncer transaction mode shart. `paginate()` — `COUNT(*)` har sahifada (katta jadvalda sekin) → `simplePaginate`/`cursorPaginate`. Laravel Pulse — slow query, Telescope — dev.
